@graph.name: Laser Teeth Whitening
@graph.description: Professional teeth whitening treatment designed to improve the appearance of certain types of natural tooth discoloration and staining.

acceptedAnswer.text: Laser teeth whitening is a professional cosmetic dental procedure intended to lighten the colour of natural teeth and reduce certain types of discoloration.

mainEntity.name: Can laser teeth whitening remove all stains?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Whitening does not guarantee that every type of discoloration will disappear. The result depends on the cause and depth of the staining.

mainEntity.name: How long does laser teeth whitening take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment time depends on the whitening system used and the patient's individual needs. The dentist can explain the expected treatment duration during the consultation.

mainEntity.name: Can sensitive teeth be professionally whitened?

acceptedAnswer.text: People with sensitive teeth should inform their dentist before treatment. The dentist can assess the cause of sensitivity and determine whether whitening is appropriate.

mainEntity.name: Will teeth whitening change the colour of crowns or veneers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whitening primarily affects natural teeth. Existing crowns, veneers and other restorations generally do not whiten in the same way as natural tooth enamel.

mainEntity.name: How much does laser teeth whitening cost in Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the whitening treatment, dental condition and treatment plan. A consultation is recommended for an accurate current cost.
